experiences.name: Gwangjang Market Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore one of Seoul's oldest and most famous traditional markets, sampling iconic Korean street foods like bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), mayak gimbap, tteokbokki, and sundae. Interact with local vendors and experience the vibrant atmosphere of authentic Korean market culture.

experiences.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace & Hanbok Experience
experiences.description: Visit the grand Joseon-era Gyeongbokgung Palace and rent a traditional Hanbok to wear while exploring the palace grounds. Enjoy free entry with Hanbok rental, watch the royal guard-changing ceremony, and visit the National Folk Museum of Korea located within the palace complex.

experiences.name: K-Pop & Hallyu Culture Tour in Hongdae
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in Seoul's K-culture epicenter in Hongdae. Visit K-pop merchandise stores, attend a live busking performance, explore indie music venues, visit SM or YG entertainment flagship stores, and try a K-pop dance class at a local studio to experience the heart of the Korean Wave firsthand.

experiences.name: Insadong Cultural Village & Traditional Tea Ceremony
experiences.description: Stroll through Insadong's charming alleyways filled with traditional Korean crafts, antiques, and galleries. Participate in an authentic Korean tea ceremony at a traditional teahouse, browse handmade souvenirs, and visit Ssamziegil, a unique open-air cultural complex showcasing local artisans and K-culture.

experiences.name: Korean BBQ & Makgeolli Night in Mapo-gu
experiences.description: Experience an authentic Korean BBQ dinner at a local grill restaurant near the Han River, grilling samgyeopsal (pork belly) and galbi (short ribs) at your table. Pair the meal with traditional makgeolli (rice wine) and finish with a relaxed evening stroll along Yeouido Hangang Park, a beloved local hangout spot.
